rules.rule: LocalStore.swift is the single mutation chokepoint for GRDB (App Group group.com.antonkosenko.timeoflifeapp). Flag any raw GRDB writes (Database.save/insert/update/delete, DatabaseQueue/Pool write APIs) outside LocalStore.swift. Watch transactional outbox, undo buffer, and sync cursor logic for races and missing transactions.

backend/api/openapi.yaml is the authoritative API contract. If this diff changes any HTTP handler, request/response DTO, or route, check that openapi.yaml is updated to match in the same PR (and that the iOS client matches). Also check Go concurrency: goroutine leaks, missing context propagation, race conditions around pgx connections, and rate-limit logic (otp/request must always return 202 to keep user enumeration closed).
OpenAPI is the contract. Any change here must be mirrored in backend handlers and the iOS client in the same PR. No backward-compat branches for on-disk/API shapes pre-release; edit shapes in place.

SwiftUI views must use Theme semantic colors only — flag any raw Color literal (Color.red, Color(hex:) etc.) in view code. New user-facing strings must be added to BOTH en.lproj and ru.lproj and to the L10n enum if enumerated — flag strings that appear in only one. Never hand-edit .pbxproj; project.yml + xcodegen only.
This is XcodeGen-managed. Hand-edits to .pbxproj must be flagged as an error: changes go through project.yml + xcodegen generate.

Sync/Keychain rules: tokens live only in the Keychain, never persisted or logged in plaintext; OTP codes are stored as SHA-256 hashes. Flag any plaintext token/code persistence, logging of secrets, or session handling that bypasses SessionCache/Keychain.
Tests must be valid: flag tests that cannot fail, tests deleted or skipped to make CI pass, and tests that assert implementation details instead of behavior.
Tests must be valid: flag tests that cannot fail, tests deleted or skipped to make CI pass, and tests that assert implementation details instead of behavior.
CI changes: permissions must be least-privileged; secrets must come from GitHub secrets, never hardcoded; timeout-minutes must be set on every job.

Process hint (advisory, never blocking): every feature/bugfix change must record its ctx7 research bundle (library IDs + queries + pins) or one-line waiver reasons in proposal/design/tasks. Flag a proposal that cites neither and waives nothing.

Process hint (advisory, never blocking): the first tasks must hold the ctx7 research bundle (and, for bugfixes, the recorded repro on the current tree); implementation tasks depend on both. Flag implementation tasks that precede research/repro.
